title: MedlinePlus places maturing color vision between four and six months
summary: MedlinePlus says color vision develops between four and six months.
body: On the newborn-development page, MedlinePlus states that color vision develops between 4 and 6 months. The line is one clause in a short sensory list, reviewed 1 January 2025. It does not say which hues, or how saturated a patch must be. A research review opened separately uses earlier ages for simpler detection, and this card does not merge the two.

sources.title: Infant - newborn development
sources.author: MedlinePlus
sources.note: Supports the sentence that color vision develops between 4 and 6 months.
